name: paseo-transfer
description: Copy or move Paseo workspaces between hosts, with Git history, local changes, and agent conversations.
author: Tom Gringauz

scripts.verify: npm run prepare && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test && node --test button-visibility.test.mjs && node --test --experimental-strip-types agent-tools.test.mjs && node --test native-tools.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.client.tsx index.server.ts client server shared/types.ts shared/connected.ts shared/rpc.ts shared/display.ts shared/limits.ts shared/git-history.ts tests scripts README.md CHANGELOG.md PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md package.json paseo-plugin.json tsconfig.json
